note: Codes: data/mexico_2025_safety.do (Bookmark #28, Q3 2024 Government Performance) keeps INEGI columns bp3_1_01..bp3_1_16, bp3_1_99, bp3_2, bp3_2a from conjunto_de_datos_ensu_cb_0924.csv (import delimited case(lower)) and reshapes long with item = column name (core model s3 pattern 1, no positional step); the bookmark is identical to Q1's #20 and to Q2's #24 minus bp3_3-bp3_6. mapping_basis=data_labels: INEGI's Q3 data dictionary labels each BP3_* column (e.g. BP3_1_02 'Problemas que enfrenta la ciudad: Deficiencias en la red publica de drenaje'; BP3_1_16 '...: Ninguno'; BP3_2 'Efectividad del gobierno de su ciudad para resolver problemas'; BP3_2A 'Conocimiento del gobierno ha implementado actividades o programas para prevenir la violencia y/o la delincuencia'); 19/19 agree in content with the Q3 questionnaire item carrying the same code number (3.1 options 01-16, 99; 3.2; 3.2a). Q3 vs Q2/Q1 (checked, not assumed): the Q3 print has NO corruption block -- Section III ends at 3.2a on p.5 and is followed by Seccion IV. Relaciones familiares; the Q3 dictionary and raw CSV carry no BP3_3-BP3_6 columns; the 38 BP3_1_*/BP3_2/BP3_2A dictionary rows are identical to Q2's, and all 19 bp3_* catalogos are byte-identical to Q2's. Q3 wording is identical to Q1 (batch_673) throughout, including option 12 printed 'fraudes, etcetera)' with no period (Q2 printed 'etcetera.)'; confirmed on a 300-dpi render of p.4; dictionary says 'etc.)'). All 26 distinct printed Spanish strings shipped (3.1 stem, 17 options, 3.2 and 3.2a stems, 4+2 printed options) are found in the Q3 PDF's text layer (pp.4-5) after whitespace normalisation -- unlike Q1, nothing rests on a render alone; 200/300-dpi renders of p.4 were read to confirm. Cross-check (route 9 style): all 19 live item vectors reproduce the raw INEGI Q3 2024 CSV after the .do's recodes, 40/40 item x level counts (e.g. bp3_1_01 0/1 = 9376/14720, bp3_1_16 0/1 = 23727/369, bp3_1_99 0/1 = 24066/30, bp3_2 1/2/3/4 = 878/6501/10211/5995, bp3_2a 1/2 = 7698/15729); raw 24096 rows = 24096 live ids, 456644 live rows. bp3_2=9 (112) and bp3_2a=9 (669) set missing by the .do. Routing (not a defect): bp3_2 blank in raw for 399 = 369 (bp3_1_16 Ninguno) + 30 (bp3_1_99), exactly the respondents with either code, matching the printed skip 'SI SE REGISTRO CODIGO 16 ... O 99 ..., PASE A 3.2a'. Words: item_text / section_prompt are the administered Q3 questionnaire wording (text_source=study_materials). Kept as printed: '(CIUDAD)' fill, 'etcetera)' in 12. Normalised: line wraps joined with a space; option 12's tight kerning (text layer drops the spaces after commas, the render shows them) rendered with normal spacing. Stripped: question numbers, option codes, dot leaders, 'ESPECIFIQUE' blank after Otro, interviewer directions (MUESTRE LA TARJETA 'C'; CIRCULE LOS CODIGOS CORRESPONDIENTES / UN SOLO CODIGO; the 3.1 skip instruction). Tarjeta C (the show card) is not in the questionnaire zip and was not transcribed. Structure: section _1 = 3.1 (stem in section_prompt, option wording in item_text), _2 = 3.2, _3 = 3.2a (stems in item_text); instructions blank -- Section III has no read-aloud introduction in Q3. Options: bp3_1_* are 0/1 flags for a circled code; option_text is INEGI's catalogo label ('0' = 'No se declaro como opcion afirmativa', '1' = 'Si', identical in all 17 catalogos), not questionnaire print. bp3_2 1-4 = Muy/Algo/Poco/Nada efectivo and bp3_2a 1/2 = Si/No are printed and identical in catalogos; code 9 'No sabe / no responde' has no row (set missing by the .do). Every level each item's respondents used has an option row. Step 3b: live items match this question block exactly (19 = 17 + 1 + 1); dictionary Description ('Resident evaluations of local and federal government security performance, Q3 2024') overstates it -- 3.1 is a city-problems checklist and 3.2/3.2a ask only about the (CIUDAD) government; the dictionary Reference names 'ENSU 2023' while data and wording are the 2024 Q3 wave (file suffix 0924) -- same defect as the siblings. English in _translated is this project's own translation (machine_translation), reused verbatim from batch_673 (Q1), whose Spanish is identical string for string; INEGI publishes no English questionnaire.
public_note: Fuente: INEGI, Encuesta Nacional de Seguridad Pública Urbana (ENSU) 2024, tercer trimestre -- IRW transcribed Section III (questions 3.1-3.2a) from INEGI's questionnaire, stripped interviewer directions, used INEGI's data-catalogue labels for the 0/1 checklist codes, and added an English translation of its own; INEGI does not endorse this item text.
